Wine Girl Magnetic Bookmark Printable Bundle Vol. 3, 5 Designs, 2x6 Inch PNG, Wine Lover Gift, Digital Download

A set of 5 wine-lover magnetic bookmark designs, ready to print at home or at a print shop: stylish women enjoying a glass of wine, each with a wine-themed journaling quote on the back panel. Print, cut, fold, and add magnets for a pretty bookmark, wine journal accessory, or gift.

✦ WHAT YOU GET
• 5 separate PNG files (Designs 11–15 of the 20-design Virgie Wine Bookmark collection)
• Each file: 1200 x 3600 px, 600 PPI, 2 x 6 inches flat / 2 x 3 inches folded
• Instant digital download, no physical item shipped

✦ THE 5 DESIGNS
1. Design 11 — burgundy glitter, woman in a coral off-shoulder blouse with white wine
2. Design 12 — purple sunset sky, red-haired woman in a black turtleneck with a glass of white wine
3. Design 13 — deep green backdrop with soft leaf shadows, woman in a green satin wrap blouse
4. Design 14 — city skyline at dusk, woman in a maroon high-collar top sipping red wine
5. Design 15 — bold tropical hibiscus florals, woman in a white halter top with a glass of wine

✦ HOW TO USE
• Print at 100% / Actual Size (do not use "Fit to Page")
• Each bookmark prints flat at 2 x 6 inches and folds to 2 x 3 inches at the center bridge
• Cut around the bookmark outline, fold at the center, and add small magnets to the inside ends to make a magnetic bookmark (magnets, paper, and printer are not included)
• The upside-down quote on the back panel is intentional; it reads correctly once the bookmark is folded

✦ FILE DETAILS
• Format: PNG, RGB (sRGB color)
• Size: 1200 x 3600 px per design (2 x 6 inches at 600 PPI)
• The artwork is supplied on a solid black background outside the bookmark outline (no transparent background) — cut along the bookmark edge
• Original artwork files; the ZIP packaging (if any) does not compress or change the images

✦ INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
Your files are available to download from Etsy immediately after payment is confirmed. This is a DIGITAL PRODUCT: no physical bookmark, magnets, or printed item will be shipped, and nothing is sent to you manually.

✦ AI DISCLOSURE
These designs were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools as part of my creative process, then hand-curated, cleaned up, and prepared for print.

✦ USAGE
